_comment: System-1 classifier decision thresholds (uplift §6). Reviewed policy config — never model output. tau decides noul questions ONLY (score/choice return their value directly, gated by confidenceFloor alone); below confidenceFloor the caller defers to its heuristic (shadow-mode contract). Initial values are conservative defaults; recalibrate from .uap/classify-shadow.jsonl once shadow data accumulates.
